race.comment: The penny has dropped for OUR HUNTRESS (5) who has put back-to-back wins together and is racing high on confidence of late. Is one from one over this track and trip and it's hard to knock mares in form. Goes on top. BEREZKA (4) strips fitter third-up, draws favourably in gate two and gets a stack of weight off with the 3kg claim. Ticks a few boxes for a race of this calibre. The well-related CHATTERLEY (8) (half to G2 winner and 2xG1 placed Mamaragan) brings NSW formlines to the table and is yet to miss a place in three first-up efforts. Can feature while fresh. SIESTA (10) has two wins and a second from three attempts over this distance range and gets in well at the weights with the claim. In the mix. MIDNIGHT SPIRIT (2) next best.
